citation.note: Manufacturers and public service corporations with 50+ employees must pay wages bi-weekly, semi-monthly, or on the 2nd and 4th Saturdays, covering earnings from the preceding 10 days (15 for public service corporations) (Miss. Code § 71-1-35).
E-Verify mandatory for all employers regardless of size: every new hire verified before or on the first day, no size exemption (Miss. Code § 71-11-3, Mississippi Employment Protection Act).

citation.section: Miss. Code § 71-1-51; no state minimum above federal
citation.note: No state minimum wage; federal FLSA $7.25/hour applies and the state's $5.15/hour figure is preempted.
Miss. Code § 71-17-5 (eff. 2022) bars sex-based wage discrimination for equal work (equal skill, effort, education, responsibility); 5+ employees; private-lawsuit-only enforcement.
Employers cannot require employees to spend paid leave on jury duty and cannot retaliate for jury service (Miss. Code § 13-5-35).
Employers may test for cannabis and discipline positive results; a medical card alone is no shield, but action taken solely on cardholder status without impairment is barred.
Breach notice in the most expedient time possible and without unreasonable delay (3 days recommended); no private right of action, Attorney General enforcement (Miss. Code § 75-24-29).
